_comment_macros: 4 × sky130_sram_1kbyte_1rw1r_32x256_8 with 2-phase reads → 256-bit weights. Single row eliminates inter-row PDN stripe DRC.
_comment_floorplan: 2400x1800 µm die (narrower than 8-macro — only 1 row of SRAMs). 4 macros in single row at y=200. Columns at x=100/650/1200/1750. Each macro 479.78×397.5 µm. Compute logic fills upper ~1200 µm.
_comment_routing: Single-row macro placement expected to eliminate inter-row PDN stripe DRC. Edge DRC at SRAM macro boundaries (met3/met4 spacing) may still occur — these are expected for sky130 SRAM macro integration.
_comment_signoff: Magic DRC disabled: Magic crashes on sky130 SRAM GDS (openram_dp_cell* unknown layer — known incompatibility). LVS errors allowed: SRAM macro power pins appear in extracted layout but not in gate-level netlist — standard black-box mismatch.
_comment_pdn_halo: PDN halos prevent met4 short/spacing violations at macro edges.
